title: LiveWave
subtitle: Live Music Discovery
description:
Discover live music concerts and festivals happening near you. LiveWave connects you with concerts for your favorite artists, helps you track upcoming events, and adds them to your calendar — never miss a show again.

• Personalized recommendations based on your music taste
• Browse concerts by city, genre, or date
• Add events to your calendar with one tap
• Get notified when favorite artists are performing nearby
